channel.title: Livable Telluride — Weekly Digest
channel.description: This week's upcoming Gov-Hub meetings and community events across the Telluride region (Town of Telluride, Mountain Village, San Miguel County, the Sheridan Opera House, The Alibi, Wilkinson Library, KOTO, telluride.com, and more).

item.title: 📅 The Week Ahead — Jun 9–15
item.description: County officials will get their first look at Colorado's new Low Energy and Carbon Code on Tuesday, a set of building standards that could change how structures get approved throughout San Miguel County. Otherwise it's a quiet week for government business, with most agendas still under wraps. The library's hosting everything from gardening camp to a free legal clinic, and there's a Livable Telluride kick-off party Wednesday.

item.title: [Wed, Jun 10] Town Talk: Can we change the weather (and do we really want to?)
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Telluride Conference Center, Mountain Village This town talk will be presented by Derek Posselt, Principal Scientist, NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory. If you live on planet Earth, you have had to worry about the weather at some point. Most of us have heard some version of the expression: “If you don’t like the weather, wait 5 minutes, and it will change.” Many of us wish we had the ability to do something about it. This is not a new impulse. Humans have been trying to change the weather for over a century. Posselt will review the ways people have tried to modify the weather, what has worked (and what hasn’t), and whether it is, in fact, a good idea to try in the first place.

item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Wilkinson Public Library, Telluride Looking to enjoy an afternoon of friendly games of mah-jongg for independent players? Join us at the Library every Wednesday from 1-3pm. Bring your 2026 card if you have one, although we have plenty of loaners if you don’t! We’ll have tables, cloths, chairs, and sets. NOTE: This is not a mah-jongg lesson. A general knowledge of the game is necessary to join. Please register in advance at telluridelibrary.org if you'd like to join so we can make sure we have enough tables set up for everyone!

item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Patagonia Telluride, TELLURIDE In collaboration with Sheep Mountain Alliance and Eco Action Partners, Patagonia Telluride will host a screening of the film, "Forever Wild".
